The '''Ministry of Security''' was the ministry of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] that dealt with [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|public security]], and was tasked with protecting "the welfare, property and livelihood" of citizens of the Empire. The [[Imperial Advisor/Legends|Imperial Advisor]] [[Bregius Golthan]] had been given a supervisory role over the ministry by [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] himself.
